title: Fourier concentration for threshold functions
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube that is a linear threshold function. For every $\varepsilon>0$, the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of its real-valued sign representation over all coordinate sets $S$ with $|S|>\lceil16/\varepsilon^2\rceil$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
